title: Truncated mdhd boxes cause an out-of-bounds read
test: tests/relayMp4.test.js: 'a header-only mdhd at the end of the init segment does not throw' and 'a malformed mdhd in the init segment does not throw out of push()' (plus 'a truncated version-1 mdhd yields a null timescale without throwing', which passed before the fix)
proof: Before the fix, npm test failed both header-only tests with RangeError ('The value of "offset" is out of range. It must be >= 0 and <= 345. Received 346') at lib/relayMp4.js:91, the mdhd version read. After the fix, the mdhd version byte is read only when the full-box header fits (mdiaBoxStart + 12 <= mdiaEnd), and the init listener in createMp4RelayStream catches track-info errors, reports them through onError and still calls onInit. Commit 5aa81f6 on lane/libmisc.
